scope: Per-GPU weight budget from observed tensor bytes (data/tensor-census) divided across the publisher-listed GPU count. HBM figures are the vendor's nominal per-device capacity. Remaining HBM is before KV cache, Mamba/sconv state, activations, workspace, communication buffers and framework reservation; it is an upper bound on what runtime caches may take, not a measured allocation.
